name: convention-property-not-literal
description: A property a row reads whose value is a template literal with a substitution is not a literal, so the run ends with the convention-not-literal setup failure naming the configuration file and the property. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
